faqs.q: Can you compete with cheap overseas clinics?
faqs.a: We don't try to win on price. Our ads put your surgeons, aftercare and results first, so we attract patients who value those things, and we filter out price shoppers before they reach your calendar.

faqs.q: Do you advertise to women as well as men?
